dedupe_keys.name: nngyk weekly communicable disease data hungary notified infections by week national and by county with weekly outbreak notes and pdf bulletins

description: NNGYK, Hungary's national public health centre, publishes each week the number of communicable disease cases notified in the country. The weekly page gives two tables, one national and one by county, comparing the current week with the same period of the previous year, together with notes on outbreaks, such as community gastroenteritis outbreaks with the numbers exposed, ill and hospitalised, and a weekly bulletin in PDF. The latest week read was week 37 of 2026. The data are free and available to download as the weekly PDF bulletin or read from the page tables; no licence terms are stated. Caveats: figures are preliminary, partly cleaned notifications registered in the week, not new cases, and they differ from the validated annual tables; only the current week is shown on the page, so building a series means collecting each week's bulletin. Simulation uses: tracking epidemic load on hospitals and primary care by county, calibrating outbreak models used in health system stress tests, and detecting waterborne or foodborne outbreaks after disruptions of water or food services. Related records: the Estonian Terviseamet statistics (data-terviseamet-estonia-communicable-disease-statistics) are a comparable national surveillance source, and the RKI emergency department surveillance (data-rki-emergency-department-surveillance) shows the hospital side.
